description: NACA 0012 steady base flow at Re=2000 by Newton-GMRES from the t = 70 snapshot of the DNS stage. Regression values of this repository, not literature values. The seed is not converged, so the first residual and the iteration count test the Newton solver, and the field statistics test its result. The sponge forces the flow toward the seed (spng_vr), so the statistics belong to this seed: Newton from another start field gives a base flow that differs by 1e-2 (relative l2 norm of the velocity), mostly in the sponge zone.

newton_first_residual.note: Residual of the seed (column 7, first row). The tolerance of the run is 1e-9, so the seed is 600 times above it.

newton_iterations.note: Newton iterations to the tolerance: the residual falls by a factor of about 5 per iteration.

newton_final_residual.note: Final Newton residual (column 7) must not exceed the Newton tolerance (column 8).

bf_vx_norm.note: Norm of vx of the converged base flow.

bf_vy_norm.note: Norm of vy of the converged base flow.

bf_vx_max.note: Largest vx of the converged base flow.
